main_measure.name: top-quintile forecast fwd 5-bar return minus flat-bar fwd 5-bar return
main_measure.threshold: excess above 0 with t >= 2 and positive in at least 2 of the coins

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation of forecast vs fwd 5-bar return on positive-forecast bars

decided_by: Inconclusive: the excess return is positive with a t below 2, or the coins disagree beyond the confirm and reject rules.
reading: The top quintile is the forecast at or above the 80th percentile of all positive forecasts, pooled over coins and windows; samples (also for the Spearman check) are the bars at positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window; and since only BTC and ETH ran, 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' and the 8-per-coin minimum are applied to the coins present.
